preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(time, str) for time in times)
preconditions.description: All elements in the input list 'times' must be strings.

preconditions.expression: all(len(time) == 5 and time[2] == ':' for time in times)
preconditions.description: Each time string must be in the format 'HH:MM'.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(time[:2]) < 24 and 0 <= int(time[3:]) < 60 for time in times)
preconditions.description: Each time string must represent a valid time of day.

postconditions.description: The return value must be a string.
The return value must be in the format 'HH:MM'.
The return value must represent a valid time interval.
The return value must be the maximum time interval between any two unique alarm times in the input list.
